They incorporate heterogeneous architectures—including homogeneous, layered, and meta-level designs—to enhance adaptability and performance in complex tasks.
  https://www.emergentmind.com/topics/multi-agent-ai-systems-mas
- Agent AI: Autonomous Multi-Agent Systems - emergentmind.com (DuckDuckGo (internet liber · zero LLM)): Agent AI integrates autonomous decision-making, dynamic planning, and robust communication to enable versatile multi-agent systems across digital and physical domains.
  https://www.emergentmind.com/topics/agent-ai
- Emergent Behavior in Multi-Agent Systems: The Path to Autonomous ... (DuckDuckGo (internet liber · zero LLM)): The journey from current multi-agent systems to fully autonomous, self-evaluating collectives will require solving difficult technical, theoretical, and ethical challenges.
  https://medium.com/@senethlakshan/emergent-behavior-in-multi-agent-systems-the-path-to-autonomous-intelligence-1e7dda3f1e3b
- Molt Dynamics: Emergent Social Phenomena in Autonomous AI Agent Populations (DuckDuckGo (internet liber · zero LLM)): These findings establish an empirical baseline for coordination dynamics in decentralized autonomous agent systems, with implications for multi-agent system design, agent communication protocol engineering, and AI safety.

- Emergent Coordination in AI & Multi-Agent Systems (DuckDuckGo (internet liber · zero LLM)): Emergent Coordination is a decentralized multi-agent system pattern where coherent, intelligent group behavior arises spontaneously from the simple, local interactions of individual agents following basic rules, without a central controller or explicit global plan.
